notes: Each launch: pristine home restored outside ~/Desktop (~/Library/Caches/tendril-benchmark/<runId>/homes), 1 discarded warmup launch(es) per app and dataset (quit 15 s after launch), then 3 measured launch(es) of 30 s interleaved ABBA. Process set sampled every 1000 ms: the app and its descendants, the WebKit XPC processes whose responsible pid is the app, and (V2) the daemon the adapter started before the app. CPU and wakeups are averaged from +15 s to the end. Windows are kept visible (no open -g); other windows on screen may occlude them.

V1 desktop app: /Applications/Ivy Tendril.app (build-info.json v1.desktopApp, version 1.2.4), launched with open -n -F --args --desktop --port <free> and IVY_TLS=0 (the shipped app uses TLS); quit with SIGINT (SIGTERM does not exit it).

V2 desktop app: ~/Desktop/tendril-benchmark/artifacts/v2/Tendril.app (build-info.json v2.appPath), launched with open -n -F and TENDRIL_SKIP_SERVICE_PROVISION=1, TENDRIL_SKIP_SERVICE_AUTOSTART=1 after its daemon (tendril serve) answered /api/health; the daemon is part of the measured set (role daemon).
warmup v1/small: window at 1250 ms, footprint 327 MiB after 15 s (discarded)
warmup v2/small: window at 237 ms, footprint 185 MiB after 15 s (discarded)

window sizes observed at the end of each measured run (points; 2x pixels on a Retina display): V1 810x566 pt (3x); V2 1152x721 pt (3x). V1 has the smaller window (55% of the other's area), so its WebKit backing stores are smaller. Each app opens at its own default size; resizing from outside needs Accessibility access, which is not granted.

WARNING: the screen was locked during 6 of 6 measured run(s) (v1/small run 1, v2/small run 1, v2/small run 2, v1/small run 2, v1/small run 3, v2/small run 3). The lock screen occludes the app windows (WebKit throttles occluded views) and new windows came up at 90% size, so memory and CPU are not representative of an app in use. Rerun with the screen unlocked.
